name: air bike v. 2

phases.label: Right elbow toward left knee; right leg extends
Left elbow toward right knee; left leg extends

source_instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the planned reps or time.
interpretation: One five-second alternating supine bicycle crunch using the accepted0003 family controls. Hands stay behind the head, shoulders raised, opposite elbow approaches the bent knee as the other leg extends. The added2395 lower-back cue uses a frozen coupled pelvis/lumbar pose, anatomy-bounded binding overlay and compact support additions. Contact is evaluated against a frozen neutral posterior-envelope profile, preserving the original skin groove; raw45/19 skin heights remain reported. This is an illustration QC approximation, not a literal flat-back or clinical technique claim.

explicit_staging.hands: Separate palms cradle the occiput with gently articulated fingers; source palm plane is measured from original geometry. No neck pull.
explicit_staging.wrists: 35degree palm/forearm deviation is an authored staging bound, not a clinical range.
explicit_staging.back: Original bilateral pelvic patches and actual lumbar ridges remain near the floor. Lower-back arch gap is measured relative to the frozen source-groove profile; see lower-back-cue-verification.json. Whole skin floor checked across151frames.
explicit_staging.timing: Opposite peaks at1.25/3.75seconds; one complete5second alternating cycle.

hip flexors.mapping: Visible sartorius and limited deep iliopsoas surface projection; not exposed iliopsoas tissue.

lower abs.mapping: Lower rectus abdominis region; a source training label, not a separate anatomical muscle.

artistic_emphasis: Stable soft warm main/additional zones; neutral inactive body. No phase-dependent physiological recruitment claim.

Three final POSITION/NORMAL targets; no extra runtime morphs. Glute repair changes binding only; rejected hip fairing is excluded.
